Upon its release, Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrated significant leaps in core reasoning capabilities compared to its predecessor, Gemini 3 Pro[1][5]. Key reported benchmark scores include:

*   **ARC-AGI-2:** 77.1% (more than double the 31.1% score of Gemini 3 Pro)[1][6][5].

As of August 2026, Gemini 3.1 Pro remains a key model in the Gemini 3 family[7].
